name: Staged: BESTÅ media wall facing the sofa and console, the whole right side a play wall
notes:
Staged pick. A BESTÅ media wall on the far wall faces the KIVIK, which floats with a LACK console against its back: the old 42" gap behind the sofa becomes the console plus a 30" route along the window. A POÄNG closes the seating into an L on the stair side, and the whole right side is Maddie's play wall: a SMÅSTAD reading bench in the window corner, a TROFAST below it, BESTÅ toy drawers filling the 77" niche, a LEN play rug and the LÄTT table.

Check the heater's surface temperature before she reads there.
toy-storage-1 TROFAST, right-upper wall y 56.375-93, x 243.625-261: bins at her height, 24" clear in front (F-32); 20 1/2" tall, no anchoring needed.
sideboard-1 BESTÅ storage combination with drawers, white stained oak effect, 70 7/8 x 16 1/2 x 29 1/8", in the 77" right-lower niche y 96.062-166.938, x 259-275.5 (6.1" spare): toy drawers and doors, solid fronts (F-63, F-61); anchor-required (F-21, 29 1/8"); 24" clear for the drawers (F-32); its front stands 2" proud of the upper wall, a built-in look.
rug-3 LEN play rug 52 x 63", x 207-259, y 96-159; kids-table-1 LÄTT with its two chairs, x 208-232.75, y 106-124.875: 26.2" from the BESTÅ fronts (F-32) and clear of the TROFAST's 24".
art-2 RÖDALM leaf cat on the window wall over the reading corner (x 217-236.75); mirror-1 LILJETRÄD on the window wall by the top landing.
shoe-cabinet-1 BISSA, bottom wall x 76-95.25, 11" deep, beside the bottom landing: anchor-required (F-21); 12" clear for its tilt-out compartments. hooks-1 HÖVOLM above it at coat height, hooks-2 FLISAT above it at Maddie's height (about 40").
Free wall: the bottom wall x 185.438-275.5 (90.1") stays clear and is reached by a 30" path (assumed-position:door: no door is drawn; the openings to the other rooms are assumed to be on the bottom wall, none on the right walls Andrew asked to fill).
Right side (F-61): the 77" right-lower wall carries the BESTÅ (70 7/8"), the 93" right-upper wall the SMÅSTAD and the TROFAST (72" of the 81" between the heater clearance and the step).
Not placed here: the chaise sofa and IDANÄS (c), the KALLAX shelf units and inserts (c, d), the KALLAX TV unit, KIVIK ottoman, STOENSE rug and PERJOHAN (b, d), the VALLABY rug (c), the kid's POÄNG and FLISAT book display (c, d: in front of the bench and the TROFAST they would block the 24" fronts or the route behind the sofa), the LAUTERS (the slim TÅGARP keeps the play corner open).
Stairs: nothing on the x 0-36 band (F-40, assumed-position:stairs); both 36" landings stay clear, and the 36" strip beside the band (x 36-72) is kept as a walkway joining them, so each landing meets the open floor with at least 30" (F-30). Nothing she can climb stands against the stair side, whose edge (wall, half wall or railing) is unknown.
Heater: every clearance is measured from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces start at y 12 or more and upholstery at y 18 or more (F-33). Window: its place on the top wall is eyeballed (assumed-position:window); curtains and rod hang there and nothing stands under it (F-38).
Kid safety (F-21): no glass anywhere; every TV unit is fixed to the wall as its page says, and the TV gets an anti-tip strap; tall storage is anchored.
Extras: GINSTMOTT curtains x2 pairs, HUGAD rod x1 (no-dimensions, an extra), SVARTPOPPEL covers x2, VALLKRASSING covers x2, FJÄDRAR inserts x4, VALLKRASSING throw x1, GNABBAS baskets x3 (console shelf), LÖVA canopy x1.
